I don't have any notes on Zephaniah 2 to give you yet. My one attempt to fetch the sources failed: the pages came back in a format my script didn't expect, it crashed, and I ran out of research tool calls before I could read any of them.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Since I haven't read any of them, any verse note I wrote now would come from my own memory and would break those rules, so I've left them all out.

**Pages I tried to fetch (not yet read):**
- Enduring Word: https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/zephaniah-2/
- Precept Austin: https://www.preceptaustin.org/zephaniah-2-commentary
- Ellicott: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/zephaniah/2.htm
- Gill: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/zephaniah/2.htm
- Pulpit Commentary: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/zephaniah/2.htm
- NET Bible notes: https://netbible.org/bible/Zephaniah+2

**What I'd add next time:**
- Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu) and Matthew Henry (ccel.org or studylight.org)
- Searches on the Reformed, Baptist, Pentecostal and Lutheran sites for the debated verses:
  - v. 3 ("perhaps you will be sheltered"): how sure salvation is, and the role of seeking
  - v. 7 and v. 9: the "remnant" and whether it means Israel or the Church
  - v. 11: whether the nations bowing in worship points to the gospel going out to all peoples
- Catholic and Orthodox readings (newadvent.org, catholic.com, oca.org)
- Bible Odyssey on when Zephaniah was written and how it was put together

If you reply "continue," I'll fetch these pages one by one, check each one loads properly, and then write the notes verse by verse, with only what the sources say and a URL after every point.
